# Zero UIV Glass Expansion Panel

A highly customizable, Uiverse-inspired Glassmorphism accordion component for Lit.

## Features

- ✅ Backdrop blur and semi-transparent background
- ✅ Elegant fade and slide transitions
- ✅ Minimalist indicator icon
- ✅ Pure CSS (No Tailwind)
- ✅ Fully customizable via RendererAttributes (Title)
- ✅ ADA Compliant

## Installation

```html
<script src="path/to/zero-uiv-expansion-glass.js" type="module"></script>
```

## Usage

```html
<zero-uiv-expansion-glass title="System Settings">
    <div>
        <label>Brightness</label>
        <input type="range" />
    </div>
</zero-uiv-expansion-glass>
```

## CSS Variables

- `--uiv-glass-bg`: Background color (RGBA)
- `--uiv-glass-text`: Text color
- `--uiv-glass-blur`: Backdrop blur amount
